description.ja: 暗い森で道を失った語り手が、丘の光を見て恐ろしい道を振り返る冒頭。
description.en: The opening passage: lost in a dark wood, the narrator sees light on a hill and looks back at the fearful passage.

it.text:
Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita
mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,
ché la diritta via era smarrita.

notes.ja: 「nostra vita（私たちの人生）」から「mi ritrovai（私は気づいた）」へ移り、人間一般の旅と個人の体験を重ねています。
notes.en: The shift from nostra vita (our life) to mi ritrovai (I found myself) places an individual experience within a shared human journey.
